_comment: PHASE FIVE-K.1 -- FIVE-K.0B §16/§20/§35/§48-49's structural analog of GOAL_PACE_TEN_K (goal-pace-ten-k.v3.json), byte-identical shape (WARM_UP/MAIN_SET(GOAL_PACE)/COOL_DOWN), reused for both FIVE_K_RACE_SPECIFIC_REHEARSAL and (at reduced dose, via the Taper week's own lower planned volume -- never a different formula) FIVE_K_TAPER_ACTIVATION. The numeric goal pace itself is computed by CatalogSessionPrescriptionPlanner.PaceFor's GOAL_PACE_FIVE_K branch (TargetFinishTimeSeconds / GoalDistanceKm), mirroring GOAL_PACE_TEN_K's own mechanism exactly -- never a new pace-derivation formula.
